description: This file defines the NotesListController class, a state management component in a Flutter application that manages the list of notes, handles connectivity status, and sync operations for a notes feature.

classes.name: NotesListController
classes.description: A controller class extending ChangeNotifier that manages the notes list, sync status, and connectivity monitoring for the notes feature.

methods.name: NotesListController
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the repository, connectivity, and sets up sync status observation.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes subscriptions, sets initial sync status, and starts observing network connectivity; intended to be called once during widget initialization.

methods.name: _onSyncStatusChanged
methods.description: Callback that updates the local syncStatus field and notifies listeners when the sync status changes.

methods.name: _subscribeNotes
methods.description: Subscribes to the notes stream from the repository based on the current search query.

methods.name: setQuery
methods.description: Updates the search query and refreshes the notes stream accordingly.

methods.name: manualSync
methods.description: Triggers a manual synchronization operation via the repository.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Cleans up stream subscriptions and listeners when the controller is disposed.
